description: Update an existing Space tag — rename it and/or change its colors. Identify it by its current name. Returns the updated tag.

name.description: Tag name (case-sensitive; used as the tag's identifier within the Space).

space_id.description: ID of the Space the tag belongs to.

tag_bg.description: Background color as a hex string, e.g. #ff0000.

tag_fg.description: Foreground (text) color as a hex string, e.g. #ffffff.

tag_name.description: Current name of the tag to update.

name: update_space_tag
